source_text: Ego sum Deus zelans. Zelus Dei amor est sponsi. Visitat iniquitatem patrum; facit misericordiam diligentibus. Non crudelitas, sed cura foederis.
pass_a_gloss: I am God jealous. Jealousy of-God love is of-bridegroom. He-visits iniquity of-fathers; he-does mercy to-loving-ones. Not cruelty, but care of-covenant.
pass_b_english: [[I am a jealous God >> Bible:Exodus 20:5]]. Divine jealousy is the Bridegroom’s love. He visits fathers’ iniquity and shows mercy to those who love him — not cruelty, but covenant care.
